description: Resolve a target (pid, container, k8s pod, or a command to spawn under capture) and open a session. Returns session_id used by every other tool. Attaching to a pid, container or pod modifies nothing; kind: "command" spawns the given program.

kind.description: Defaults to auto-detect: numeric → pid, ns/name → pod, else container. Spawning a command requires kind: "command".

target.description: pid, container name/id, k8s pod (ns/name), or a command line (with kind=command)

name: attach
title: attach
